android.desc:
Build a lasting reading habit with Bookmory, the ultimate reading tracker.

Set your yearly reading goals, track your daily reading progress, and keep a beautiful reading journal.
With a powerful reading timer, calendar view, and detailed reading stats, staying motivated has never been easier.

When you record a book in Bookmory, you don’t just track it —
you remember it forever.

⸻

📖 Perfect for Readers Who Want To:
• Track books they read
• Build a consistent reading habit
• Keep a reading journal & reading notes
• Set reading goals and achieve them
• View beautiful reading statistics
• Organize their personal book library

⸻

✨ Key Features

📚 Easy Book Tracking
• Add books via search or barcode scan
• Organize books with collections & series
• Manage your library with custom tags
• Rate and review finished books

⏱ Reading Timer & Progress Tracker
• Log pages read
• Track reading time with a built-in reading timer
• Set daily reading goals
• Set yearly reading goals
• Stay motivated with a reading streak feature

📝 Reading Journal & Notes
• Write beautiful reading notes with a powerful editor
• Highlight your favorite quotes
• Extract text from photos using OCR
• Share notes with aesthetic backgrounds
• Random note feature to revisit past insights

📊 Reading Stats & Calendar
• Yearly reading statistics
• Track pages and reading time trends
• Reading calendar to visualize your progress
• Annual Rewind feature (available every December)

🎨 Customization & Security
• Multiple themes to match your style
• App lock with password protection
• Google Cloud backup support

⸻

👑 Premium Features
• Remove all ads
• Automatic sync across multiple devices
• No manual backup required
• Additional exclusive themes

⸻

📚 Your All-in-One Reading Tracker

Bookmory is more than a book tracker.
It’s a reading log, reading journal, reading timer, and reading goal app — all in one place.

Track your books.
Measure your reading time.
Build a lasting reading habit.

Start your reading journey with Bookmory today. ✨

Contact: tonysoft.net@gmail.com

quotes.text:
I have switched to StoryGraph, and I don't look back.

I read books in five languages, and I read a lot of old ones, too, that are from pre-ISBN era. Not finding them on Goodreads and not being able to add them was a serious drawback. GR demands an online book webpage to add a book, which don't exist for a lot of niche books I read.

StoryGraph totally solved it.

And I also use Bookmory [0] for regular tracking and sharing pretty visuals. You should give Bookmory a try.

[0]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.tonysoft.bookmory
quotes.story_title: There is still the need for a better Goodreads alternative
